requiredCapabilities: Creative capacity modeling and governance for brand rollout

assignments.mission: Deliver a clear A/B/C recommendation. Weigh strategic upside vs delay/liquidated damages risk. Judge how much PMO + standard templates de-risk execution; assess residual bottleneck from 20% non-standard sites. Define non-negotiable contract terms (wave-based acceptance, penalty caps, exception thresholds, change-control, client 24h SLA). State the single condition most likely to flip the decision.

Build an 18-week approval/capacity model using stated staffing (CD 75%, 2 SDs from wk3, production team). Estimate weekly throughput for standard sites and exception reviews; map critical path for creative approvals and QA; identify queue risks from 20% bespoke sites; recommend governance (triage, escalation, templates) and whether a week-18 full cutover is feasible or phased waves are required.

reason: Decision hinges on two domains only: strategic/contract risk and creative approval capacity. No external research is allowed or needed. Business strategist integrates the final A/B/C with non-negotiables; brand/creative quantifies throughput and bottlenecks to inform feasibility. This is the minimum sufficient collaboration for a high-stakes contract decision.
